summary: Builds the player stats display page. Seeds three word buffers from word_5C694C, derives a default path prefix from byte_5EA438, updates the global track-name string dword_7CE668 to match this[96] (field at this+0x180) when they differ, then walks the race-result linked list (head dword_7D2DC0, cursor dword_7D2DC8). For the head entry and then each list entry it formats the grand-prix name, race number and lap time and creates one UI menu item per column label (UIListIndexedAccessor 0, 1, 2), prefixing each item with the path buffer and emitting a blank separator item before every list entry.

operations.description: Seed local buffers: v23 = byte_5EA438[0] (default path prefix), v24/v25 cleared; each of v29, v28, v27 starts with word_5C694C followed by memset zeroed tails.
Resolve track-name strings: v1 = this[96] (field at this+0x180) falling back to byte_5EA438; v2 = dword_7CE668 falling back to byte_5EA438.
When strcmp(v2, v1) is non-zero the global track-name string dword_7CE668 differs from this[96]; it is updated via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.
dword_7D2DC8 = dword_7D2DC0 copies the race-result list head into the walk cursor.
If dword_7D2DC0 (list head) is non-null and its node holds an entry, the head entry is formatted specially before the loop.

StringCopyWithValidation(v29, 64, aGrandprixname, entry name or byte_5EA438) copies the grand-prix name; on success sub_587DD0(v29, name, 63) post-processes it and the high byte of the v30 terminator is cleared.
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v27, "%d", race number at entry+16) formats the race number into v27.

Lap time: CRTFtol converts the seconds float at entry+20; minutes = v/60; when minutes > 0 the remainder seconds float is reduced by 60*minutes; then StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v28, "%i:%06.3f", v/60, remainder) formats minutes and seconds into v28.
StrlenOverwrite(&v23) fixes the length/termination of the path prefix buffer after assembly.

For column labels 0, 1 and 2: UIListIndexedAccessor(label) fetches the label, StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v31, "%s%s%s", label, path buffer, data buffer) composes the item text, and UIMenuItemCreator(v31, 0, 0, 0, 0) creates the menu item.

Walk the race-result linked list: advance the cursor dword_7D2DC8 to *(node+4) and take the entry from the node; while an entry exists, emit a blank separator item (StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v31, byte_5EA438) + UIMenuItemCreator), then format the grand-prix name, race number and lap time into items exactly like the head entry, and advance.
Returns the final cursor value read from dword_7D2DC8 (the last node visited, or 0 when the list is empty).

clean_pseudocode: formatGrandPrixName(v29, cursor); formatRaceNumber(v27, cursor); formatLapTime(v28, cursor);
